field.note: owner reads about 45 mm on the board; confirm with calipers

slot_width.source: calipers on the owned Cinque 5.2, powder coat included

pitch.source: derived as slot width + rib width; tighten by measuring across four slots

grid_phase.source: no board has been measured for absolute rib position

open_questions: Grid phase is unmeasured: where the first rib centre falls relative to the board origin. Every placement is relative-only until one rib position is taken.
The project owns a Cinque 5.2, not a 5.4. Slot numbers are carried over from the 5.2 and from the official 5.4 drawing.
notes: The drawing is not uniformly scaled: it measures 847 px across for 1002 mm but 266 px tall for 424 mm, a 35 percent anisotropy. Only printed dimensions are usable; never scale off its pixels.
Slots run along +X, so ribs also run along +X and the keeper arch reaches along +Y.
Any two clips must sit a whole number of pitches apart.
